Hi, I'm Dr Joseph Cipriano DC located in Tampa, Florida. I'm a Chiropractic Doctor out here to change the World one patient at a time! I take a full body approach with all my patients to maximize the effectiveness of my treatment and keep you feeling better longer!  I have an office in Tampa, Fl.  Tampa Florida is our Main Location! All of the people you see in my videos are real, actual patients. My Y STRAP spinal decompression adjustments get the results people have been searching for. I'm here to help my viewers with their health. I get the severe chiropractic cases that other medical professionals don't want to deal with.  ASMR loud Chiropractic Back Cracking Adjustments. Your Favorite Y Strap Doc

To schedule an appointment...
Visit: www.YstrapDoc.com
Email: DrJosephCipriano@gmail.com
